Edit Log Book

Pick a machinery and dates – all its entries open together

Change any reading – everything updates live. When you change a Close, the next row's Start follows it. Add missing dates or delete rows, then press Save changes. Nothing is saved until then.
A Night entry for a date that already has its entry: tick that row and press + Add row; tick ½ for a half night.

One row = one trip. + Add row for another trip – the trips of a Day / Night go into that shift's entry (one entry a date and shift). Change or take out a row, then press Save changes. Nothing is saved until then. Export Excel gives these trips with empty lines to fill; Import Excel adds the file's trips (many tankers and dates at once).

    Verification rules

    Tick a work of this site: its saves go to the people of level 1, then level 2 …, and are saved only when the last level approves.

    Any one person of a level approves (the others are the backup). Nobody approves his own entry. The Super Admin's own entries are saved at once.

    Only when (optional): only entries dated more than N days back, or (diesel) more than X litres. Empty = every entry. A work added to the app later shows up here by itself.
